set.input.play.help: Easy play: no arming (the first stick or key starts the motors), the drone holds its height, keys like a game (W A S D move, arrows turn and climb), and a pilot school that takes the help away step by step. Pilot: as a radio — the ARM button or Space, a throttle that stays where you leave it, Mode 2 keys (W/S throttle, A/D yaw, arrows pitch and roll). A radio or a gamepad always flies as a radio.
set.input.altitudeHelp.help: The drone holds its height by itself; up and down (the arrows, or the left stick on a touch screen) climb and sink at a steady speed. Works in angle mode only: horizon and acro can flip, and there your throttle flies. Step 1 of the pilot school.
set.input.haptics.help: A short buzz when you crash with the touch sticks, on phones that allow it (most Android phones; not iPhone).
play.keys.title: Keyboard · easy play
play.keys.updown: up / down (with altitude help; without it, the throttle, which stays where you leave it)
play.keys.throttle: throttle up / down, stays where you leave it
play.keys.motors: tap: motors on; hold half a second: motors off (easy play; pilot keys: arm / disarm)
play.keys.motorsShort: tap: motors on · hold: motors off
play.keys.pilotNote: Pilot keys as on a radio (Mode 2, Space arms): Settings → Controls.
play.gate.keys: Press a flying key to take off
play.gate.touch: Touch a stick to take off
play.touch.hint.climb: Left stick: up / down and turn. Right stick: fly.
play.touch.hint.throttle: Left stick: throttle (stays) and turn. Right stick: fly.
play.hud.keys: K keys · R respawn · P pause · H hide text
play.school.title: Pilot school
play.school.about: Each step takes some help away. Fly the seconds of a step without a crash to unlock the next one; you can pick any step.
play.school.step1.about: The drone levels itself and holds its height.
play.school.step2.about: It still levels itself; you hold the height with the throttle.
play.school.step3.about: Levels near the centre, flips at full stick.
play.school.step4.about: No self-levelling: how real FPV pilots fly.
play.school.reached: Goal reached: {goal} s without a crash!
play.school.finished: You fly acro without a crash. Real sticks are next: a radio or a gamepad connects on the Controls screen.
